reclassified_blocker.explanation: Not merely drift. Current canon_registry v0.1 explicitly records uid_seed_format operator|ordinal|device and rule companion_device_shares_ordinal_distinct_uid. profiles.js faithfully implements that spec. Topology canon simultaneously defines NODE=HUMAN. Both artifacts are internally consistent with their own spec; collision is between specs' vocabulary: 'node_uid' is device-derived while 'Node' is human. Fixing only profiles.js would diverge code from registry. Canon vocabulary + implementation must converge together via versioned additive change.
